0.original: Maru is anxiously awaiting someone's return.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

48.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, you haven't seen a broodin' Rider carryin' a couple of jugs of valras oil, have you?

49.original: He's a tough bloke, so I didn't think twice about sendin' him off to pummel valras─but now I'm worried somethin' might've happened.

50.original: I reckon you're even tougher than he is, so would you mind seekin' him out? He should be on the Perfumed Rise somewhere─an' hopefully he ain't dismantled.

51.original: ...I owe you my thanks. Circumstances forbade my retreat.

52.original: I shall retrieve the oil and return posthaste. Tell this to Maru, if you would.

53.original: Upon seeing this fragile creature in mortal peril, I am shamed to admit that I forgot myself... Tell Maru I shall return with the oil anon.

54.original: Did you find him in one piece?

55.original: Of course he did... He's usually a sober-minded fellow, but all bets are off when a little critter gets involved.

56.original: Anyway, I'm relieved to hear he's alright. Wasn't sure what I was gonna do if he wasn't...

57.original: I'll keep this in mind the next time I send him out on a job. Thanks for helpin' out as always, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!
